subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Blowing smoke
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Blowing smoke"** means to lie to perplex others or to make insubstantial or misleading statements. (धोखा देने के लिए झूठ बोलना)

 
 
• **Example:** He was just blowing smoke when he said he could finish the project in one day.
 
 
 
• **"Lie to perplex others"** refers to making false statements to confuse or mislead someone. (दूसरों को भ्रमित करने के लिए झूठ बोलना)
 
 
• **Example:** The politician was accused of lying to perplex others about his involvement in the scandal.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To hide something** (कुछ छिपाना): To keep something secret or concealed.

 
 
• **Example:** He tried to hide something by not mentioning the crucial details.
 
 
 
• **To tease someone relentlessly** (किसी को लगातार चिढ़ाना): To mock or make fun of someone continuously.
 
 
• **Example:** They would tease someone relentlessly about his new haircut.
 
 
 
• **To burn something important** (कुछ महत्वपूर्ण जलाना): To destroy something of significance by burning it.
 
 
• **Example:** He accidentally burned something important, which contained all the project details.
